entities.name: Gonzalo Ronquillo de Peñalosa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gonzalo Ronquillo de Peñalosa, sometimes spelled as Gonçalo Ronquillo Peñaloza, was the fourth Spanish governor and captain-general of the Philippines from April 1580 until his death in 1583. He was succeeded by his nephew, Diego Ronquillo. Before arriving in the Philippines he served as royal court marshal in Mexico.
